title: Concept of Operations (ConOps) Specification Schema
description: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema defining the complete data contract for Concept of Operations (ConOps) specifications in accordance with ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018, OMG UAF v1.2/v2.0, and JARUS SORA v2.5.

metadata.description: Document metadata and formal governance attributes.

system_identifier.description: Unique system identifier or title (e.g., AutonomousSystemArchetype).

title.description: Full formal title of the Concept of Operations document.

author.description: Designated author, team, or engineering organization.

target_system.description: Target cyber-physical system or product realization identifier.

operational_context.description: Section 1: Scope, domain context, boundaries, and stakeholder roster.

operational_boundaries.description: Physical, legal, and operational boundaries of the system.

stakeholder_roster.description: Identified stakeholders, operators, regulators, and support personnel.

deficiencies.description: Section 3: Current operational baseline and deficiency analysis.

current_operational_baseline.description: Description of current legacy or predecessor operations.

operational_deficiencies.description: Exhaustive breakdown of technical, human, and operational deficiencies.

proposed_capabilities.description: Section 4: Operational justification, value proposition, and trade-off analysis.

mission_drivers.description: Core drivers and requirements demanding new capabilities.

value_proposition.description: Quantified or qualitative operational value delivered.

trade_off_analysis.description: Formal engineering trade-offs evaluated across design alternatives.

user_classes.description: Formal user and operator classes interacting with the system.

title.description: Descriptive title of the user class.

player_or_operator.description: Classification as direct operator, player, supervisor, or automated agent.

interfacing_stakeholder.description: External stakeholder organizations or regulatory interfaces.

characteristics.description: Operational traits, expected experience, and responsibility scope.

training_type.description: Formal qualification, certification, or training standard.

constraint_source.description: Regulatory or normative requirement source governing this role.

airspace_sora.description: Section 6: 4D Operational Volume and SORA Ground Risk Buffer mathematics.

h_max_m.description: Maximum operational ceiling / altitude above reference surface (m).

e_impact_joules.description: Estimated kinetic energy at operational boundary impact (J).

ground_risk_class.description: JARUS SORA Ground Risk Class designation (e.g., GRC-3).

uaf_activities.description: Section 7: OMG UAF Operational Activity Taxonomy with Gate 24 allocation tags.

name.description: Formal activity name matching UAF operational activity definition.

description.description: Technical description of the operational activity.

information_element.description: Name or payload type of the exchanged information.

throughput.description: Expected exchange frequency or bandwidth throughput (e.g., 100 Hz, 10 Mbps).

max_latency.description: Maximum allowable end-to-end transport latency (e.g., 5 ms).

criticality.description: Safety / assurance criticality level (e.g., High, DAL-A).

environmental_envelopes.description: Section 9: Operational environments, physical envelopes, and constraints.

environmental_ingress.description: Ingress protection rating (e.g., IP67) or precipitation constraints.

rf_environment.description: Electromagnetic interference, GNSS-denial, and RF constraints.

physical_spatial_constraints.description: Spatial clearance, staging dimensions, or launch footprint.

scenarios.description: Section 10: Multi-threaded operational scenarios and mission timelines.

title.description: Descriptive title of the operational scenario thread.

elapsed_time.description: Relative or absolute elapsed timeline marker (e.g., T+00:00:00).

actor.description: Responsible actor, subsystem, or human role.

action.description: Action executed during this timeline step.

exit_criterion.description: Mandatory gate or transition criterion to advance to next step.

maintenance.description: Section 11: Maintenance and sustainment concepts (O/I/D Maintenance levels).

o_level.description: Organizational-level maintenance activities and pre-flight inspections.

i_level.description: Intermediate-level maintenance, calibration, and modular LRU replacement.

d_level.description: Depot-level structural overhaul, deep inspection, and recertification.

emergency_matrix.description: Section 12: 7-Row Emergency Decision and Contingency Matrix.

detection_mechanism.description: Sensor, watchdog, or BIT mechanism detecting the anomaly.

primary_failsafe_state.description: Deterministic failsafe recovery state or autonomous mitigation mode.

authority_role.description: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) authority or autonomous authority designation.

automated_containment_action.description: Autonomous action taken immediately upon trigger detection.
